success.description: 4{Dc} The object or character the target attempted to interact with is simply not there - the real character or object (if it ever existed at all) has been nearby and invisible the whole time; it now becomes visible.
As above, but the object or character has been disguised as a different object or character nearby; the two items have exchanged places.

boon.description: Add or remove 1 recharge token from one of your Grey Order spells.

bane.description: You fooled your allies, too! Increase party tension by 1.

conservative.requirements: 6 power, all elements of your illusion must be within medium range. You play this card when the target attempts to interact with a friendly character or an inanimate object for the first time in a given scene. That object or character is revealed to be an illusion.
